entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Cathedral of St. Mark the Evangelist is a Baroque church located in the center of the town of Makarska, on Andrija Kačić Miošić Square. It serves as the co-cathedral of the Archdiocese of Split-Makarska and was the episcopal seat of the former Diocese of Makarska.
